downgradeConfirm: Downgrading to Henchman removes access to doomsday devices at the end of this billing period. Any device that is still armed will be politely disarmed, and your minions will be told it was their idea.
seatsHenchmanNote: Each henchman needs a seat. Minions ride free.

refundPolicy: You can request a refund within {{days}} days of purchase, as long as the device was never switched on. Schemes that were foiled by a hero do not count as unused, however strongly you feel about it.
cancelConfirm: Cancel your subscription? Your lair stays yours, but the shark tank, the death ray and the monthly minion pizza budget stop at the end of the period. You can come back any time; villains usually do.
billingCycleAnnual: Billed yearly (two months of tyranny free)
